program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (filter (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) r0) (= (first p) r1) (= (second p) c0) (= (second p) c1)))
              (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1)))
    (define (same-cells? a b)
      (and (= (length a) (length b)) (all? (lambda (p) (member? p b)) a)))
    (let ((frames (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 6)) (objects g 0))))
      (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj frames])
        (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
               (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb)) (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb))
               (border (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)))
          (if (same-cells? (obj-cells obj) border)
              (paint-cells out (positions-in-rect (+ r0 1) (+ c0 1) (- r1 1) (- c1 1)) 8)
              out))))))
